y-m-04-01.title: Same number 245: models fit different?
y-m-04-01.topic: Place value of three-digit numbers (show am with hundreds, tens, and ones models)
y-m-04-01.goal: Check say dem fit show di same three-digit number in several ways by changing di combination of models, and explain why di whole number stay di same even when di number of models different.
y-m-04-01.material: Use number models. Hundreds model show 100, tens model show 10, and ones model show 1. Plenty models of each kind dey. Minho show 245 with 2 hundreds models, 4 tens models, and 5 ones models. Seoa talk, 'Na only dis way to show 245.'

y-m-04-01.thinking.2: Comparing different ways to show di same value

y-m-04-01.s.s1.prompt: Wetin you think about wetin Seoa talk? You fit show 245 with fewer than 2 hundreds models?

y-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.1: Count how many tens models you need to put down to fill di amount wey decrease.
y-m-04-01.s.s1.o.a: No. Di hundreds digit for 245 na 2, so exactly 2 hundreds models must dey
y-m-04-01.s.s1.r.a: Dis idea match di digit 2 straight with 2 hundreds models. When you show with models, think whether you fit show 100 with other models too.
y-m-04-01.s.s1.o.b: Yes. You fit use other models to show di 100 wey one hundreds model represent
y-m-04-01.s.s1.r.b: Dis idea see say di value of one model fit be shown with several other models. Check which models and how many to use.

y-m-04-01.s.s1.r.c: Dis idea miss one condition. Dem don write already say plenty models dey. Read di condition again and judge.
y-m-04-01.s.s1.explain: If you remove 1 hundreds model (100) and put down 10 tens models (100), di total still dey 245. One way dey to use only 1 hundreds model, so di words 'di only one' no correct.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.prompt: Make 3 different ways to show 245. Show am with a hundreds models, b tens models, and c ones models. Use 9 ones models maximum (we agree say if 10 ones models dey, we go swap dem for 1 tens model).

y-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.1: Reduce hundreds models one by one and fill di amount wey decrease with tens models.

y-m-04-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Number of models must be 0 or more.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.ok.c2: You use whole models without cutting dem.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Models no fit cut, so di number must be one wey you fit count, like 0, 1, 2....
y-m-04-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Di numbers wey hundreds, tens, and ones models show must add up to 245.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.fail.c4: We agree to use 9 ones models max.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.explain: If ones models na 9 or fewer, dem don fix ones models as 5, and na only di way to split di other 240 between hundreds and tens models dey change. (2, 4, 5), (1, 14, 5), and (0, 24, 5) all fit.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Write why di total exactly 245 even when number of models different.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Choose one combination wey you make and talk which model you swap for which models.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Write how many tens models equal di number wey one hundreds model show.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: For your explanation, e clear how many models you swap for one hundreds model?
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: E include words say di total stay di same even when you swap di models?
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: You use one of di combinations wey you make as example?
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.model.0: 1 hundreds model na di same as 10 tens models, so di total stay the same even if you swap dem. So even if you change (2, 4, 5) to (1, 14, 5), e still be 245.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.model.1: If you remove one hundreds model, 100 go reduce, but if you add 10 more tens models, 100 go increase, so di sum na di same.
y-m-04-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Explanation wey talk clearly about swapping as 'remove and add'.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.prompt: Among di ways wey you just make, which one use di fewest models? Count di models by adding hundreds, tens, and ones models together.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.hint.0: Choose di three ways one by one and write total number of models.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.hint.1: Put di totals side by side and find di smallest.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.o.a: 0 hundreds models, 24 tens models, 5 ones models
y-m-04-01.s.s3.r.a: If you no use any hundreds models, tens models go be di most. When di kinds of models reduce, di number fit actually increase.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.o.b: 1 hundreds model, 14 tens models, 5 ones models
y-m-04-01.s.s3.r.b: If you reduce hundreds models, you need dat many more tens models. Add all di numbers for all three ways and compare.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.o.c: 2 hundreds models, 4 tens models, 5 ones models
y-m-04-01.s.s3.r.c: Dis idea add and compare di number of models for each of di three ways.
y-m-04-01.s.s3.explain: Di number of models na 29, 20, and 11. Di more high-value models you use, di fewer models you need. Even for di same number, di model count different according to which models you use.

y-m-04-02.title: 4 for each of 3 plates, 3 for each of 4 plates
y-m-04-02.topic: Meaning of multiplication (number inside one group and number of groups)
y-m-04-02.goal: Use dot array check why 3×4 and 4×3 get di same value, and distinguish say even when di values same, di 'story' (number of groups and number inside each group) no be the same.
y-m-04-02.material: Read multiplication 3×4 as '4 groups of 3', and 4×3 as '3 groups of 4'. (3×4 dey read "three times four" and 4×3 dey read "four times three".) Each plate get same number of apples, and no apple remain or miss. Doyun talk, 'Four plates with 3 and three plates with 4 get different grouping, so number of apples go different too.'

y-m-04-02.thinking.2: Distinguishing wetin be the same and wetin different

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Di conclusion fit be correct, but dis idea talk am without checking.

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: You fit only turn di dots, so you fit talk say number na the same for multiplication of other numbers too
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Dis idea see say di reason 'number of dots no change when dem turn am' fit work for other numbers too.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Di apples for both cases na the same, 12. Doyun talk again, 'Number of apples na the same, so both stories exactly the same.'

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Di number of apples na the same, 12, but 3 plates and 4 plates, and 4 for each plate and 3 for each plate different. Even if di values be the same, di stories no be the same.

y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Number of apples na the same and number of plates different
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Dis idea separate wetin be the same and wetin different.

y-m-04-11.title: How far 9 times-table pattern correct?
y-m-04-11.topic: Tens and ones digit pattern in 9 times table
y-m-04-11.goal: Use more examples to test how far pattern from few examples hold; find break point, and state condition "correct up to here."
y-m-04-11.material: Eunwoo notice pattern memorizing 9 times table: "Each step in 9 times table, tens digit go up 1 and ones digit go down 1." (e.g. 9,18,27...) If one-digit product, treat tens digit as 0. Extend 9×1 through 9×11. 18 9
y-m-04-11.thinking.0: Update how sure you be with new information
y-m-04-11.s.s1.prompt: Follow Eunwoo claim as information come one bit at a time.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.hint.0: Write each product split into tens and ones digits.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.hint.1: Compare how tens and ones change between neighboring products.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wetin you think about Eunwoo claim now?
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.after: For 9,18,27,36,45 tens digits 0,1,2,3,4 increase 1; ones 9,8,7,6,5 decrease 1. But we only check 5 products. 0 1 18 2 27 3 36 6 7 8 9 9
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: This idea check whether claim fit data we see.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Wrong. Ones digit decreasing just coincidence
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: This idea reject without checking. Split 9,18,27,36,45 into tens and ones digits. 18 27 36 9
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: This idea decide whole pattern from five. More products not checked yet.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Continue: 9×6=54, ×7=63, ×8=72, ×9=81. In each, as Eunwoo say, tens digit rise 1 and ones drop 1. 9 9 9
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: How much you trust him now?
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.after: Pattern correct up to 9×9. Beyond not checked, so adding condition or waiting are both reasonable.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: You can say true for multiplication table through 9×9
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: This idea add condition: correct only within data range seen.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I only check through 9×9, so I no know beyond that
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: This idea postpone judging untested range.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Now I sure 9×10 and 9×11 correct too
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: This idea jump to products outside checked range. Choose one product to check again.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.info: 9×10=90. Tens digit grow 8 to 9 and ones shrink 1 to 0. 9×11=99. Tens stay 9, ones grow to 9. 1 1
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: How should we fix Eunwoo words now?
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Pattern correct 9×1 through 9×10=90, then break at 9×11=99. Add condition: "pattern correct in 9 times table through 9×10."
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: This idea no include new information from 9×11=99.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: This idea miss pattern still correct through 9×10.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: This idea separate correct range from breaking point.
y-m-04-11.s.s1.reflect: At first, five data points make you think correct, but you could add condition or delay judgment. Only after 9×11=99, you learn range. Say what info change your confidence.
